 Sunday marks final day of early voting in N.Y. state
 BY 
 Spectrum News Staff
 New York State 
 UPDATED 1:50 PM ET Nov. 01, 2026 
 PUBLISHED 10:28 AM ET Nov. 01, 2026 
 PUBLISHED 10:28 AM EST Nov. 01, 2026 
 SHARE 
 Sunday is the final day of early voting before the midterm election in New York state.
 You can cast your ballot from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. at most locations.
 The latest unofficial numbers from the New York State Board of Elections show that more than 1.1 million upstate New Yorkers have cast their early votes through Saturday. This includes nearly 90,000 in Erie County, more than 87,000 in Monroe County, more than 52,000 in Onondaga County and more than 37,000 in Albany County.
 Polls are closed on Monday.
 Election Day is Tuesday at your normal, assigned polling site.
 And Tuesday night, be sure to join Spectrum News 1 for our Election Night coverage. We'll have team coverage bringing you the latest updates on races from across the state. Our live broadcast begins at 8 p.m., one hour before the polls close.
